about: Chambly is a Montérégie city on the Richelieu River at the Chambly Basin, on Montréal’s South Shore. A stone fort, canal locks, and a waterside old town recall its role on the Montreal–Lake Champlain military and trade route. Rapid suburban growth now surrounds the historic basin. About 31,000 people live in Chambly.
seoSummary: South Shore Richelieu city at the Chambly Basin, known for Fort Chambly and the canal locks.
